name: Blitzkrieg Target
description: Shows the percent your current Blitzkrieg run has to reach next to the percentage

enabled.name: Show run target
enabled.description: Add the percent the current Blitzkrieg run has to reach to the percentage, like <cy>44.27%/74.27%</c>.

show-passed.name: Show for passed runs
show-passed.description: Keep showing the target when the run from this start position is already passed in the current stage.

decimals.name: Target decimals
decimals.description: Decimal places of the target percent.

slash-gap.name: Space around the slash
slash-gap.description: How far the slash sits from the percentages on each side. <cy>0</c> is no space, <cy>15</c> is a full space.

percent-below.name: Percentage under the bar
percent-below.description: In levels with a Blitzkrieg profile, centre the percentage under the progress bar. Needs the progress bar turned on in the game's options.

markers.name: Run markers on the bar
markers.description: Draw a line on the progress bar where the run starts and another where it has to get to.
